before:
Wellness Suite — Member Arrangements

The wellness suite on the second floor is a day spa. It is open to all members without referral, booked through the app in half-hour slots. Towels and robes are provided at the desk. The suite's two treatment rooms may be booked singly or together, and the sauna operates on a walk-in basis during staffed hours. Guests accompanying a member may use the suite on the member's booking. Staffed hours are eight to eight on weekdays and nine to five at weekends. Suggestions go through the app's comment card and are reviewed monthly by the site team.
after:
Wellness Suite — Member Arrangements

The wellness suite on the second floor is an outpatient clinic. It is open to all members without referral, booked through the app in half-hour slots. Towels and robes are provided at the desk. The suite's two treatment rooms may be booked singly or together, and the sauna operates on a walk-in basis during staffed hours. Guests accompanying a member may use the suite on the member's booking. Staffed hours are eight to eight on weekdays and nine to five at weekends. Suggestions go through the app's comment card and are reviewed monthly by the site team.
variation_site: In the opening sentence, what the suite is said to be changes from a day spa to an outpatient clinic.
author_note: Only the entity's stated kind moves; every permission in the text — no referral, walk-in sauna, guest use, booking terms — is restated word for word, while the clinic designation merely IMPLIES a different permission regime.

before:
Programme Panel — Year One Note

The panel met six times, with attendance above eighty percent at every session. The panel is an advisory body to the programme director. Its recommendations go to the director, who decides and answers for each outcome. Papers circulated a week ahead in all but one case, and minutes were posted within five days of each session. Two recommendations were taken up in full, one in part, and one held for costing. Membership turns over by thirds each year, with the first rotation due in March, and the panel's self-review is scheduled alongside that rotation.
after:
Programme Panel — Year One Note

The panel met six times, with attendance above eighty percent at every session. The panel is the governing board of the programme. Its recommendations go to the director, who decides and answers for each outcome. Papers circulated a week ahead in all but one case, and minutes were posted within five days of each session. Two recommendations were taken up in full, one in part, and one held for costing. Membership turns over by thirds each year, with the first rotation due in March, and the panel's self-review is scheduled alongside that rotation.
variation_site: In the second sentence, what the panel is said to be changes from an advisory body to the governing board.
author_note: The very next sentence still routes every recommendation to the director, who decides — the stated decision path is untouched; a governing-board designation implies authority the text does not grant.

before:
Guided Walk — Delivery Steps

1. Collect the route card and the group list from the office.
2. The walk leader, a volunteer guide, briefs the group at the meeting point.
3. Keep the group on the waymarked paths for the whole route.
4. Count the group at each marked checkpoint.
5. Radio the office at the halfway shelter.
6. Any change of route is decided by the office, not on the hill.
7. Return the route card with observations noted on the back.
after:
Guided Walk — Delivery Steps

1. Collect the route card and the group list from the office.
2. The walk leader, a certified mountain instructor, briefs the group at the meeting point.
3. Keep the group on the waymarked paths for the whole route.
4. Count the group at each marked checkpoint.
5. Radio the office at the halfway shelter.
6. Any change of route is decided by the office, not on the hill.
7. Return the route card with observations noted on the back.
variation_site: In step 2, what the walk leader is said to be changes from a volunteer guide to a certified mountain instructor.
author_note: Steps 3 and 6 still confine the route to waymarked paths and reserve route decisions to the office — the stated permissions are unchanged; the credential upgrade only IMPLIES wider latitude.

before:
Complaint Handling Timetable

All durations in this timetable are counted in working days. An acknowledgement is sent within three days of receipt. A full response follows within ten days, or within twenty days where a site visit is needed. Escalation to the review officer opens once the full-response window has passed, and the review itself concludes within fifteen days. Where a deadline cannot be met, the complainant is told before it passes and given a revised date. The timetable is printed on the acknowledgement letter so that every party counts from the same dates.
after:
Complaint Handling Timetable

All durations in this timetable are counted in calendar days. An acknowledgement is sent within three days of receipt. A full response follows within ten days, or within twenty days where a site visit is needed. Escalation to the review officer opens once the full-response window has passed, and the review itself concludes within fifteen days. Where a deadline cannot be met, the complainant is told before it passes and given a revised date. The timetable is printed on the acknowledgement letter so that every party counts from the same dates.
variation_site: In the opening sentence, the counting basis for all durations changes from working days to calendar days.
author_note: Reads like one local checkable statement of practice, but it is the base convention: the three-, ten-, twenty-, and fifteen-day clauses all keep their text and change their meaning — ripple, not local.

before:
Footfall Review — High Street Counters

All comparisons in this review are against the 2019 reference year. Saturday counts finished the year up twelve percent, with the strongest quarter in autumn. Weekday counts sit four percent below, concentrated in the early-afternoon band. The market square counter, installed mid-year, is excluded from comparisons until it holds a full year of data. Counter uptime exceeded ninety-eight percent at all four positions. The lighting works closed the arcade position for nine days in February; those days are patched from the neighbouring position in the usual way. Next year's review adds the two station exits.
after:
Footfall Review — High Street Counters

All comparisons in this review are against the 2024 reference year. Saturday counts finished the year up twelve percent, with the strongest quarter in autumn. Weekday counts sit four percent below, concentrated in the early-afternoon band. The market square counter, installed mid-year, is excluded from comparisons until it holds a full year of data. Counter uptime exceeded ninety-eight percent at all four positions. The lighting works closed the arcade position for nine days in February; those days are patched from the neighbouring position in the usual way. Next year's review adds the two station exits.
variation_site: In the opening sentence, the reference year for all comparisons changes from 2019 to 2024.
author_note: Which year was used is itself checkable, which is the trap; but the change propagates — up twelve percent and four percent below keep their text and change their meaning, where a local figure change would stay put.
